summary:
The sources subsystem turns every supported site (classic boorus, tube sites, FurAffinity, kemono/pawchive, local virtual feeds) into one uniform BooruHandler API that the feed, viewer, tag builder and settings consume.
Core: lib/src/handlers/booru_handler.dart (abstract BooruHandler, 1413 lines) owns the search pipeline (searchSetup -> sourceQuery (Source settings default filters/always-add) -> translateOrSyntax (cross-booru a|b) -> validateTags -> makeURL -> fetchSearch (DioNetwork + captcha interceptor) -> parseListFromResponse/parseItemFromResponse -> afterParseResponse (filterFetched, DB favourite/snatched flags, TagHandler queue)), plus parallel pipelines for tag suggestions (Either<ResponseError,..>), comments, notes, counts, loadItem, account (signIn/isSignedIn), site favourites, media hooks (getMediaHeaders, mediaOutageNotice, onMediaError, beforeMediaRetry, thumbnailFallbacks) and ~40 capability getters the UI reads.
filterFetched implements every feed filter (blacklist per source/global, marked, AI, favourited/snatched with live exemptions, media-type chips, duplicates, doujin blacklist separation) and the hiddenBy counters.
BooruHandlerFactory maps BooruType -> handler with per-source startingPage (paging rule: runSearch increments pageNum before the first fetch) and caches per-booru media headers/handlers for the image loader; several boorus => MergebooruHandler.
BooruType (enum persisted by NAME in boorus.json/backups) lists types, dropdown/detectable/saveable sets and display aliases. SiteProfile (per-host deviations: bakemono, kemono) is resolved by host.
~45 concrete handlers in lib/src/boorus/: JSON/XML API engines (Danbooru, e621, Gelbooru family incl. rule34.xxx via api host, Moebooru, Philomena, BooruOnRails, Szurubooru, Sankaku/Idol, Hydrus, InkBunny, Civitai, World/XYZ, Nozomi packed indexes, Rule34.dev Next.js data), HTML scrapers (GelbooruV1, Realbooru, R34US, R34Hentai, Shimmie/paheal, Rainbooru, WildCritters, AGNPH), tube sites (Hanime1 with dictionary + Google translate, Kusowanka, RedGifs, Rule34Video with query grammar and phone-side type walk, TikPorn, XXXTik keyset + Firebase login, XXXFollow), FurAffinity (query grammar, parser, session in own file + jar seeding), kemono/pawchive (KemonoSite config, KemonoApi with 401 relogin, creator index in DB, file-host probe, session file), local feeds (Downloads with file reconciliation, Favourites, Collections, History, Merge).
Per-source UI pages (kemono artists/DMs/announcements/post page, FurAffinity post page) live in lib/src/pages and talk to handlers + SearchHandler directly.
Infrastructure in this subsystem: DioNetwork (one shared pooled HttpClient, per-request Dio with logging/alice/cookie interceptors, 429/503 retry, captcha auto-webview, SAF streaming download), Tools (UA invariant, WebView cookie jar with timeout/pause, media headers, captcha page, file names), http_overrides (proxy/root cert), html_parse/html_color (notes/comments to spans), text_parser (comment markup rules), extensions, debouncer, status_bar_inset.
Wiring today is singleton-heavy: handlers, models (BooruItem, BooruType) and utils reach into SettingsHandler, SourceSettingsHandler, DoujinDataHandler, TagHandler, NavigationHandler and even widgets (webview_page, flash_elements), which is the main source of layer violations a restructure must cut by injecting small interfaces (settings reader, DB repositories, app paths, cookie jar, webview env).

features.name: Unified source search pipeline
features.navPath: automatic (every feed tab: scroll to load next page, pull to refresh)
features.what: Builds URL from tags, applies source-settings query composition, cross-booru OR translation, validation, fetch with captcha check, parse, filter, DB flags, tag typing; locks the feed when a page adds nothing; special error text for rule34.xxx 'Missing authentication' and gelbooru/rule34 401 with a link to Settings > Booru & Search

features.name: Feed filters (blacklist, marked, AI, favourited, snatched, duplicates)
features.navPath: Settings -> Tags & filters (remove hidden/marked/AI/favourited/snatched toggles); automatic on every feed
features.what: filterFetched hides blacklisted posts per source (global list unless the source ignores it), marked-tag posts, AI posts, already favourited/snatched posts (not on own lists: Downloads/Favourites/Collections/History), duplicates by fileURL/serverId; items favourited/snatched while browsing stay visible until reload (live exemptions); counts per reason feed the 'whole page hidden' banner; blur state hiddenInSource follows the same rules

features.name: Media-type filter chips
features.navPath: Favourites / Downloads tab -> filter chips (All / Images / Videos / Sound)
features.what: BooruHandler.mediaFilter applied in filterFetched (image incl. animation, video, sound by sound tags)

features.name: Doujin/booru blacklist separation in feeds
features.navPath: automatic (doujin tabs, merge tabs, doujin For You)
features.what: Doujin items are judged only by their source's doujin blacklist (per item host in mixed feeds), never by booru hidden/marked lists; doujin hearts come from the doujin store; doujin tag names never enter the shared tag store

features.name: Cross-booru OR syntax (tag1|tag2)
features.navPath: Search bar: type a|b
features.what: Translated per engine: ~a ~b (Danbooru/e621 with ( ) grouping), {a ~ b} (gelbooru.com, realbooru), ( a ~ b ) (rule34.xxx/safebooru), (a || b) (Philomena/BooruOnRails); dropped with a log warning on engines without OR (Sankaku, Shimmie, Nozomi, Hydrus, local, tube sites); hasNativeOrSupport tells the UI

features.name: Source settings query composition and Filters card
features.navPath: Settings -> Boorus & Search -> edit source -> Source settings (default filters, always add); Search window -> Filters
features.what: sourceQuery composes default filters and always-add terms into every search (not for doujin, local, feeds, merge, or id lookups); siteFilters builds the Filters card from the handler's doujinFilters or from its sort/order/rating metatags (BooruSiteFilters), with engine cheat-sheet filters for Danbooru and Gelbooru families

features.name: Per-source notes on Source settings
features.navPath: Settings -> Boorus & Search -> edit source -> Source settings (notes block)
features.what: BooruSiteNotes lists live-checked quirks per site (gelbooru/rule34.xxx need API key, realbooru API offline, danbooru 2-tag limit, derpibooru filters, paheal, r34us, rule34hentai, kusowanka, idol, FurAffinity, kemono) plus capability lines (sign-in, favourites sync, comments, notes, suggestions, tag builder)

features.name: Tag suggestions (autocomplete)
features.navPath: Search bar -> type a tag
features.what: Per-source suggestion endpoints with HTML-entity decoding and a 20-item cap; local DB usage counts on Favourites/Downloads/Collections; local dictionary (hanime1), creator index + tag snapshot (kemono), snapshot (rule34video), five namespaces (kusowanka), vocabulary + elastic index (tik.porn), niche catalogue (redgifs niche:), merge routes N#tag to the Nth booru

features.name: Comments and translation notes
features.navPath: Viewer -> info sheet -> Comments / Notes button
features.what: getComments/getNotes pipelines; supported on Danbooru, e621, Gelbooru (HTML), Gelbooru-alikes (API + rule34.xxx HTML fallback for single comments), Moebooru, Philomena, BooruOnRails, Szurubooru, Sankaku/Idol, Shimmie/paheal, kemono/pawchive (404 = none), tik.porn

features.name: Total result count
features.navPath: Feed header count badge
features.what: searchCount per source (Danbooru counts API, gelbooru @attributes, XML posts count, local DB counts, merge sums children); countIsQuestionable for phone-filtered rule34video

features.name: Load item on open (needToLoadItem)
features.navPath: automatic when a post is opened in the viewer; Retry re-resolves
features.what: loadItem resolves real file URLs / tags for sources whose grid lacks them (FurAffinity, Realbooru, R34US, Hanime1, Kusowanka, Rule34Video signed mp4s, Danbooru/Gelbooru/rule34.xxx tag types and counts, Idol HTML, World/XYZ tags, kemono detail)

features.name: Tag typing into the shared tag store
features.navPath: automatic (tag colours in viewer/tag cloud)
features.what: addTagsWithType keeps ownTagTypes per handler and writes to TagHandler when storeTagsGlobally; populateTagHandler queues untyped tags (skipping doujin items) to be typed through the booru tag API

features.name: Videos/GIFs-only preview filter cycle

bugs.title: Merge tabs drop every md5-less item after the first page
bugs.scenario: Merge tab with Nozomi/RedGifs/kemono/FurAffinity/Civitai/tube sources (items with md5String == null). Page 1 shows items; on page 2 every md5-less item is logged 'Skipped because hash match' and never shown
bugs.evidence: search(): for boorus not in isBooruWithoutMd5 it calls hashInFetched(fetched, item.md5String, ...); hashInFetched returns true when fetched[i].md5String == hash, and null == null is true once page-1 items without md5 are in fetched

bugs.title: saveCookies ignores every cookie attribute and truncates values containing '='
bugs.scenario: A Set-Cookie 'sess=abc==; Path=/; Domain=.site.com; Expires=...; Secure' from any Dio response is stored in the WebView jar as sess=<last segment after '='> with path '/', no domain, no expiry (session cookie), not secure
bugs.evidence: parts = c.split(';').map((p) => p.split('=')); value = parts.first.last (last '='-segment, not the remainder); attributes are matched with p.first.toLowerCase() == 'domain' but p.first keeps the leading space from split(';') (' Domain'), so domain/path/expires/secure/httponly are never found; Expires (HTTP-date) would also not parse with DateTime.tryParse

bugs.title: FurAffinity session cookies written to the log unredacted on every request
bugs.scenario: Logged-in FurAffinity user exports logs (Settings -> Debug -> Logger): every FA search/comment fetch has a line 'https://www.furaffinity.net: a=<session>; b=<session>' - full account session
bugs.evidence: FurAffinityHandler.getHeaders adds Cookie 'a=..; b=..'; BooruHandler.getCookies merges it and logs '${booru.baseURL}: $cookieString'; redactSecrets has no rule for cookie names a/b and the line has no 'Cookie:' prefix for the generic header rule

bugs.title: InkBunny session id logged in clear
bugs.scenario: Signed-in InkBunny account: log contains 'Inkbunny session token found: <sid>' and every search URL '...&sid=<sid>&...'
bugs.evidence: setSessionToken logs the sid; makeURL embeds sid=$sessionToken and BooruHandler.search logs the URL; redactSecrets parameter list does not include sid

bugs.title: Artists page shows stale results when filters change during a load
bugs.scenario: Tap a service chip, change sort, switch mode, or type a name (250 ms debounce) while a page is loading (or the index refresh finishes mid-load): the list keeps the OLD query's rows and the new query is never run
bugs.evidence: _reset() clears _rows/_offset then calls _loadMore(), which returns immediately because _loading is true; the in-flight _loadMore then appends its old-query rows and advances _offset. Same pattern in kemono_messages_pages.dart _reset/_loadMore (DM search)

bugs.title: rule34video loses tag-id routing when Source settings add default filters or always-add terms
bugs.scenario: Set a default Sort filter (or always-add term) for rule34video in Source settings, then search a tag name: the request goes to the text search instead of /tags/{id}/ (and the content filter is not applied server-side)
bugs.evidence: search() resolves `source` without sourceQuery; BooruHandler.search then builds tags = validateTags(translateOrSyntax(sourceQuery(tags))) and makeURL(tags) finds _isCurrent(tags) false, so it re-parses with parseQuery (no DB resolution) and unknown names become text search

bugs.title: Nozomi and Hydrus ignore Source settings default filters and always-add terms
bugs.scenario: Source settings offers a Sort default for Nozomi (from its sort: metatag) and Sort/Order for Hydrus; choosing one has no effect on searches
bugs.evidence: Both handlers override search() and never call sourceQuery() (NozomiHandler.search line 71, HydrusHandler.search line 76), unlike BooruHandler.search

bugs.title: Different posts with the same numeric id from different sources are hidden as duplicates
bugs.scenario: Merge tab (or any mixed feed) loads post 12345 from site A and an unrelated post 12345 from site B: the second is hidden with HiddenReason.duplicate
bugs.evidence: filterFetched isDuplicate = filteredItems.any((e) => e.fileURL == item.fileURL || (e.serverId != null && e.serverId == item.serverId)) with no source/host check

bugs.title: Civitai '-tag' exclusion can end the feed early
bugs.scenario: Search with an exclusion that removes every item of one API page: the base sees no new items and locks the feed although later pages have results
bugs.evidence: parseItemFromResponse returns null for excluded items; BooruHandler.search sets locked = true when fetched.length did not change

bugs.title: AGNPH deferred tags can land on the wrong post
bugs.scenario: A page contains a post without file_url (skipped); every later post's tags are written onto the post after it (index shift); tags also arrive after the feed was filtered so the blacklist never applies to AGNPH
bugs.evidence: newIndex = fetched.length + index uses the raw response index while skipped posts are not added; getTagsLater writes fetched.elementAt(fetchedIndex).tagsList asynchronously after afterParseResponse/filterFetched

bugs.title: Requests without explicit headers lose the browser User-Agent
bugs.scenario: DanbooruHandler.getUploaderName (info sheet uploader name) calls DioNetwork.get without headers: the request goes out with dart:io's default 'Dart/x' UA, breaking the one-UA invariant
bugs.evidence: get(headers = const {}) -> mergeOptions(options, {}) -> usedOptions.copyWith(headers: {...?headers ?? usedOptions.headers ?? defaultOptions.headers}); the non-null empty map wins so defaultOptions headers (with User-Agent) are dropped

bugs.title: Double-slash URL cleanup in loadItem is a no-op
bugs.scenario: Post pages with '//' inside paths keep them; intended normalisation never happens
bugs.evidence: item.thumbnailURL.replaceAll('(?<!https?:)//', '/') passes a String (literal) pattern, not a RegExp

bugs.title: rule34hentai login cookie values cut at the second '='
bugs.scenario: A session cookie value containing '=' (base64 padding) is stored truncated, so the login silently fails

bugs.title: downloadCustom keeps a paused response stream when the SAF file cannot be created
bugs.scenario: SAF folder lost permission: the future errors, but the code continues to listen; the first chunk throws on fileUri! in onData after subscription.pause(), leaving the connection held open
bugs.evidence: completer.completeError(...) when fileUri == null has no return; stream.listen onData calls subscription.pause() then writeStreamToFileFromSAFDirectory(fileUri!, data)

bugs.title: Tracked-values update can index a list that was reset meanwhile
bugs.scenario: Feed refreshed (fetched reset) while the favourite/snatched DB lookup of the previous page is still running: fetched[fetchedIndexes[index]] throws RangeError, surfacing as a search error
bugs.evidence: setMultipleTrackedValues awaits dbHandler.getMultipleTrackedValues then indexes fetched by the pre-await indexes without re-checking length

bugs.title: Hanime1 post identity changes with the session's working domain
bugs.scenario: After a Cloudflare block flips the session to hanime1.com, posts get .com postURLs; favourites/seen/history saved under hanime1.me no longer match the same video
bugs.evidence: makePostURL => '$_base/watch?v=$id' and _base replaces the host with the static _workingHost

bugs.title: NyanPals and WildCritters hidden from the type list only when debug is ON
bugs.scenario: Normal users see the debug-quality types; debug users do not
bugs.evidence: ..remove(isDebug ? BooruType.NyanPals : null)..remove(isDebug ? BooruType.WildCritters : null) - condition looks inverted

bugs.title: RedGifs clears the user token on the shared Booru object
bugs.scenario: A 401 (IP change) sets booru.apiKey = '' on the Booru instance shared with the settings list; a later settings save persists the cleared key and the user is silently logged out
bugs.evidence: fetchSearch 401 branch and signOut assign booru.apiKey = ''

bugs.title: Gelbooru XML refusal reason never shown
bugs.scenario: gelbooru.com answers XML with a rate-limit reason: the user gets a type error instead of the reason
bugs.evidence: the try around 'parsedResponse = response.data' cannot throw, so the XmlDocument.parse branch that extracts the reason is unreachable; parsedResponse['post'] on a String then throws

fragile.rule: Never call close() on a Dio returned by getClient (its adapter would close the shared HttpClient for the whole app).

Every request/WebView/media fetch uses Tools.browserUserAgent (custom UA setting > device WebView UA > app UA). Documented exceptions only: Danbooru app UA, Sankaku/Idol app UAs, nonWebViewUserAgent for Schale. Cloudflare binds cf_clearance to UA.

runSearch increments pageNum before the first fetch; default -1 => first request page 0; 1-based sites get pageNum 0 from the factory (Moebooru, Danbooru, e621, Philomena, Sankaku, RedGifs, XXXFollow, ...). Kemono offset = page*50; FA/Hanime1/Kusowanka/Rule34Video compute page = pageNum+1 themselves.
Enum value names (case-insensitive) are stored in boorus.json, backups, DB rows and share links; never rename/remove a value, add new ones only.

fragile.what: BooruItem.key is a GlobalKey used as the viewer widget key
fragile.rule: Keep one GlobalKey per BooruItem instance (state reparenting and current-item lookup); equality is effectively identity because key is in props.

fragile.what: Media headers are separate from API headers and cached per type|baseURL
fragile.rule: Hotlink-protected sources must override getMediaHeaders; media_headers_test guards the table. sendsJarCookiesToMedia=false for FurAffinity and e-hentai must hold (session never sent to image hosts).
Pass the same headers map instance across rebuilds or every rebuild refetches every picture.
prevTags is set only after a successful parse; currentTags is set before the fetch and is what parsers that depend on the query must read (FA, doujin).

filterFetched, then await setMultipleTrackedValues (DB favourite/snatched flags), then filterFetched again; favourite/snatched filters only on page load, live exemptions cleared only on a new query; own lists (isLocalDb) ignore filterFavourites/filterSnatched (r85).
Doujin items never use booru blacklists/marked tags/tag store; checks are per item (host) so merge feeds stay separated; doujin hearts come from DoujinDataHandler.

Not applied to doujin sources, local DB views, recommendation feeds, merge, webview, or id lookups (applySourceSettings=false, e.g. _R34HentaiHandlerDummy). Handlers overriding search() must call it themselves.

getCookies attaches the booru SITE host's jar (captcha clearance) while the interceptor adds the REQUEST host's jar; rule34.xxx API lives on api.rule34.xxx, so the explicit getCookies is not redundant.
Every CookieManager call is bounded by cookieJarTimeout (5 s) and a timeout pauses the jar for 30 s; reads are deduped per host; captchaScreenActive must be reset in finally.

kemono API needs Accept: text/css; one automatic re-login on 401, max once per minute per user; session file keyed '<site>|<user>' with bare-key migration; never prefetch pawchive files (IP block); thumbnails on pawchive are WebP under .jpeg; file host probe freshness 10 min; post detail cache 10 min/50.
a/b live in furaffinity_session.json AND are seeded into the jar before FA webviews (prepareWebView) and synced back after (syncAfterWebView); logout scrubs the jar; images never get the session.
No Flutter imports so the grammar tests run without bindings.

fragile.where: GelbooruHandler/RealbooruHandler (no padding {a ~ b}) vs GelbooruAlikesHandler (padded ( a ~ b ))
fragile.rule: Verified against live APIs; the wrong padding returns zero posts.
Listing only for sort:/source: queries; a failed scrape disables the listing for the handler's life and serves the page from the API (never an empty grid).
knownTagIds/knownUploaderIds are static and shared; _isCurrent keeps a changed per-source default from splicing into a grid mid-pagination; walkFiltered advances pageNum.
Keep these names (or update tests in the same change).

fragile.where: Hanime1Handler._workingHost/_translationCache, RedGifsHandler._token, Rule34DevHandler._buildId, CivitaiHandler._tagIdCache, TikPornHandler vocab, WorldXyzHandler auth maps, XXXTikHandler Firebase session, FurAffinityHandler._users/_folders
fragile.rule: Shared across handler instances on purpose (handlers are rebuilt per tab/search).
Must strip the dangling '?' (hanime1 Cloudflare blocks 'path?&a=b'); tags[] and repeated tag= params are built by hand in Hanime1/KemonoSite.
Keep the per-handler doc comments (endpoints, quirks, dates verified) when moving files.
